_comment: Template: copy to <lang>.json (e.g. hi.json, ar.json, ko.json) and translate the values. Keys you omit fall back to English, so a partial file is fine. Drop it in ~/.immurok/localization/ to override the bundled pack.

wizard.accessibility.description: immurok needs accessibility permission to simulate keyboard input for automatic screen unlock.
wizard.accessibility.title: Accessibility Permission
wizard.complete.hint: You can enable "sudo Authorization" in settings to use fingerprint for sudo.
wizard.complete.title: Setup Complete
wizard.connect.body: immurok pairs with your Mac as a Bluetooth keyboard. First, connect the device once in the system Bluetooth settings:
wizard.connect.searching: Waiting for the device to connect…
wizard.connect.step1: 1. Make sure the device is charged, powered on, and near your Mac
wizard.connect.step2: 2. Open System Settings > Bluetooth, find “immurok IK-1” in Nearby Devices and click “Connect”
wizard.connect.step3: 3. Once macOS connects, come back here — the app discovers the device automatically
wizard.connect.title: Connect Your Device
wizard.fp.body: Just like Touch ID: repeatedly lift and rest your finger on the sensor, following the arrows to adjust the angle until the progress completes.
wizard.fp.hint: Enroll the finger you use most (index finger or thumb). You can add more later in Fingerprint Management.
wizard.fp.title: Add Your Fingerprint
wizard.intro: immurok is a macOS Bluetooth fingerprint authentication system for:
wizard.intro.next: Some configuration is required before use.
wizard.menubar.note: immurok lives in the menu bar and keeps running in the background; closing windows won't quit it. It starts automatically at login.
wizard.pair.body: Pairing creates an encrypted channel between the app and your device, so only this Mac can use it. You'll press the device button once to confirm.
wizard.pair.need.connect: Waiting for the device to connect first
wizard.pair.title: Pair With Your Device
wizard.pam.needpkg.hint: Please run the immurok installer package (immurok_install.pkg) to install the PAM module.
wizard.pam.title: PAM Module
wizard.password.body: Enter your Mac login password. After a fingerprint match, the app types it for you to unlock the screen.
wizard.password.privacy: The password is stored encrypted in your local Keychain only — never sent to the device or the network.
wizard.password.title: Set Unlock Password
wizard.subtitle: Complete the following setup for first use
wizard.title: immurok Setup Wizard
wizard.try.sudo: When running sudo in Terminal, touch the sensor instead of typing your password
wizard.try.title: Try It Out
wizard.try.unlock: Press ⌃⌘Q to lock the screen, then touch the sensor with your enrolled finger — it unlocks automatically
wizard.welcome.needs: You'll need your immurok fingerprint device (charged). Keep it near your Mac throughout setup.
wizard.welcome.time: Takes about 3 minutes — you can tap “Later” to exit anytime.
pairing.press.fp.button: Touch an enrolled finger, then press the button on the device…
dualhost.clear.waitfp: Touch an enrolled finger to confirm…
dualhost.clear.confirm.title: Unbind Host %d?
dualhost.clear.confirm.message: That computer will no longer be able to authenticate with this device. Fingerprints and keys on the device are unaffected, and a new host can be bound afterwards. Requires one touch of an enrolled finger.
dualhost.clear.failed: Could not unbind. Check that the device is connected and touch the sensor before it times out.
unpair.done.local.only: Local pairing data cleared. The device was not connected, so its slot is still occupied — unpair again once it reconnects, otherwise re-pairing will fail.
unpair.message.lastslot: This is the last host bound to the device. After unpairing, the device knows no computer at all while its fingerprints remain — re-pairing is then impossible without a factory reset, which also destroys every SSH private key stored on the device. To move to a different computer, bind the new one first, then come back and unpair this one.
pairing.guide.title: Two steps to finish pairing
pairing.guide.step.fp.detail: Place your finger on the sensor at the top of the device to prove it is you.
pairing.guide.step.button: Press the button on the bottom
pairing.guide.step.button.detail: A single short press. The device blinks white while it waits.
pairing.guide.cancelhint: To stop: long-press the device button, or do nothing and it cancels after 30 seconds.
dualhost.card.otherhint: To fill this slot, open immurok on that computer and click Pair.
